sources.note: Main company website. Describes Theoria as tech-enabled value-based primary care for senior living communities. Lists product suite: ChartEasy, ChatEasy, ProphEasy, Telemedicine, RPM.
ONC certification page and mandatory disclosures. Lists ChartEasy v1.5 certified 2024-12-04 with 34 criteria and 10 CQMs. Describes patient portal access and EHI export via PDF/CCDA.

ChartEasy product page. Describes automated scheduling, medication reconciliation, polypharmacy/GDR support, documentation management, CCM and RPM modules, bidirectional integrations with PointClickCare, MatrixCare, American HealthTech, hospital EMRs, and lab/imaging companies.
RPM program page. Monitors heart rate, respiration rate, motion, presence, SpO2. Two device options. Diagnosis-specific vital range alerts. Data flows to ChartEasy and facility EHR.

ChartEasy Patient Portal iOS app listing. Free app, iOS 12.3+. Features: lab results, vital signs, medication list, CCM care plans, signed encounters, record sharing (PDF/CCDA). Minimal ratings/reviews.

MatrixCare partner listing. Describes bidirectional integration: MatrixCare sends demographics, ADT, meds, vitals, diagnoses to ChartEasy; ChartEasy sends signed progress notes back to MatrixCare instantly.
PointClickCare marketplace listing for Theoria Medical. Page did not render useful content (mostly CSS/JS).
Medigy product listing. Confirms supported terminologies: ICD-9, ICD-10, SNOMED CT, LOINC, NDC, RxNorm, CPT, HCPCS, RadLex, MEDCIN. Web and multi-platform support.
Skilled Nursing News article about Theoria joining ACO REACH through Empassion Health. Discusses value-based care strategy, emphasis on tech backbone, claims-based alignment for SNF residents.
January 2024 press release on Empassion Health partnership for ACO REACH High Needs program. Theoria serves hundreds of locations across 21 states.
December 2024 article on Amulet Capital Partners investment in Theoria Management MSO. Confirms national scale and value-based care focus.
Crunchbase profile. Founded 2019, Novi MI. Page returned 403 error so limited detail obtained.
